Updated assessment incorporating the Beige Book:
- FOMC tone remains: labor market “strong,” activity “solid,” inflation below 2%, and “patient” guidance; policy steady with IOER tweak—neutral to slightly accommodative.
- Beige Book (March–April, across Districts) indicates only slight-to-moderate growth, with consumer spending mixed for general retailers and auto dealers, manufacturing cooled amid trade-related uncertainty, and agriculture pressured by excessive rainfall/flooding; price and wage pressures modest.
- Together with SLOOS signals of tighter standards and softer loan demand, underlying momentum looks weaker than the headline FOMC language implies, reinforcing a cautious, near‑neutral stance.
